summary: A schedule change for the May 1971 Network Working Group meeting. Dr. Roberts could not attend Monday afternoon, so the network planning and other ARPA projects topics move to Tuesday evening. It also corrects the reading list for Wednesday evening.

plainLanguage.summary: This note changes two parts of the Network Working Group meeting plan. It moves two topics to Tuesday evening and corrects which RFC attendees should read.

subtitle: A revised agenda and reading correction for an NWG meeting.

tldr.problem: Dr. Roberts could not attend the Monday afternoon session but could attend Tuesday evening.
tldr.mechanism: The note moves Network Planning and other ARPA Projects to Tuesday evening and uses Monday afternoon for as many of the original Tuesday topics as possible.
tldr.outcome: It also corrects the Wednesday reading to RFC 131 rather than RFC 113. The unit metadata says RFC 149 updates RFC 140.

today: The unit metadata lists RFC 149 as Unknown and says it updates RFC 140. The text is a meeting notice and records no protocol specification.

sections.title: The Meeting Schedule
sections.content:
Dr. Roberts was unlikely to attend the Monday afternoon session, but could attend Tuesday evening. The note therefore moves the topics Network Planning and other ARPA Projects to Tuesday evening.

On Monday afternoon, attendees will cover as many items originally planned for Tuesday evening as they can.
sections.plainLanguage: Two topics move to Tuesday evening because Dr. Roberts can attend then. The group will use Monday afternoon for as many of Tuesday's other topics as time allows.

sections.title: The Correct Reading
sections.content: The relevant reading for Wednesday evening is RFC 131, not RFC 113. The note also says attendees should read all RFCs issued since the previous Network Working Group meeting.
sections.plainLanguage: Attendees should read RFC 131 for Wednesday, not RFC 113. They should also catch up on RFCs issued since the previous meeting.

sections.title: Scope of the Note
sections.content: This one-page RFC records meeting logistics and a reading correction. It does not specify a network protocol. The unit metadata says it updates RFC 140 and lists its status as Unknown.
sections.plainLanguage: This RFC is a meeting notice, not a technical protocol. Its metadata says it updates RFC 140.

references.text: RFC 131, identified as the relevant reading for Wednesday evening.
RFC 113, identified as the incorrect reading in the earlier schedule.
